protocol.purpose: Select added diagonal damping g for synthetic stable coupled modes, minimizing J=trace(X_g)+0.15*g^2, where A_g=A-gI
protocol.certificate: Same Lyapunov residual trace bound; numerical covariance certification only, not plant robustness or real control safety
methods: adaptive Krylov then Schur on certificate failure
work POD48 then adaptive Krylov then Schur on certificate failure

protocol.selection: Eliminate candidates whose lower objective bound exceeds the smallest upper bound; if remaining intervals overlap, recompute all potential winners with Schur; abstain if numerical intervals still overlap
protocol.timing: Each policy runs fresh matrices, full certification, fallback and selection end to end with one BLAS thread; independent Schur oracle excluded from policy time
